entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker from Dominaria, twin of Nicol Bolas, who pursues knowledge, created Tarkir's dragons, and imprisoned the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Ugin's twin, a power-hungry elder dragon planeswalker who killed Ugin, later fell in the War of the Spark and was imprisoned by Ugin.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Ugin and Bolas were born.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where Ugin's elemental storms birthed the dragons.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which the Eldrazi were imprisoned in the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: The plane where Ugin and Bolas fought, where Ugin was reborn and later merged his essence to imprison Bolas.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes where Bolas was cast.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: The being from whom Ugin and Bolas were spawned during the Birth of the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Merrevia Sal
entities.description: Ugin and Bolas's sister, killed by humans and dogs.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: A dragon sibling who became dragonlord of a human settlement and fought Bolas.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: A sibling who mocked the twins' size and hunting techniques.

entities.name: Te Ju Ki
entities.description: An old holy elder who befriended Ugin and taught him of other planes.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who traveled back in time to save Ugin and later helped him against Bolas.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who awakened Ugin with Sorin's Restoration and helped imprison the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi and whose help Ugin sought.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans lured to Zendikar and imprisoned in the Eye of Ugin for 6,000 years.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The Zendikar structure imprisoning the Eldrazi, activated by three planeswalker sparks and Ugin's breath.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: A network of stones powered by leylines and coded by draconic runes that formed the Eldrazi prison.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem and shatters when his spell fails.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The alliance that destroyed Ulamog and Kozilek, rebuked by Ugin.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Ravnican dragon who allied with Ugin and stabbed Bolas with Hazoret's spear.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A God-Eternal who delivered the fatal blow to Bolas.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A planeswalker who devised a plan with Ugin to trap Bolas on Ixalan.

entities.name: Spirit-Gem
entities.description: A gem tied to Ugin and the Meditation Realm, taken by Bolas and later stolen by Jace.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who spoke with Ugin through the Spirit-Gem.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: A character in Caligo who held the Spirit-Gem.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who accompanied Jace to the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps clear the group's minds in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who attacks Bolas to distract him.

entities.name: Breath of Ugin
entities.description: Ugin's invisible colorless flame, his greatest creation and a key to the Eye of Ugin.

events.summary: Ugin and Bolas are spawned together from the Ur-Dragon, witnessing their sister attacked by humans.
events.quote: They witnessed their sister Merrevia Sal being attacked by humans and dogs .

events.summary: Ugin realizes Bolas never truly cared for him, igniting his spark and planeswalking to the Meditation Plane.
events.quote: This mental shock caused his planeswalker's spark to ignite and he planeswalked to the Meditation Plane .

events.summary: Ugin returns to Dominaria and rejects Bolas's offer to rule, cementing their rift.
events.quote: The brothers exchanged bitter words before Ugin left Dominaria again, cementing the rift that had grown between them.

events.summary: On the Meditation Plane Ugin lets Bolas fatally wound him, shattering the plane and casting Bolas into the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: Ugin returned to the Meditation Realm and allowed his brother to fatally wound him.

events.summary: Ugin is reborn as a Spirit Dragon in a body formed from the Realm's waters.
events.quote: Ugin awakened, his spirit inhabiting a new body formed from the Meditation Realm's waters.

events.summary: Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri lure and imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar for 6,000 years.
events.quote: The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi caused the three Titans to become trapped in the plane for 6,000 years.

events.summary: Bolas tracks Ugin to Tarkir, gravely injures him, mines his mind for Eldrazi information, and leaves him to die.
events.quote: leaving the grievously wounded Ugin to die.

events.summary: Sarkhan travels back through the Nexus of Fate and uses a hedron shard to create the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon, saving Ugin and changing Tarkir's timeline.
events.quote: Sarkhan created the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon to save Ugin and thereby alter the fate of the entire plane.

events.summary: Sorin's Restoration awakens Ugin from his cocoon of hedrons, and Ugin learns the Eldrazi have awakened.
events.quote: With Sorin's Restoration , the vampire awakened and freed the spirit dragon from his slumber.

events.summary: Ugin meets Sarkhan and theorizes a time paradox.
events.quote: he theorized that Sarkhan had now created a time paradox of sorts.

events.summary: Ugin warns Jace about the hedron network and berates the Gatewatch for killing Ulamog and Kozilek.
events.quote: Ugin berated them for killing the ancient creatures instead of trapping them

events.summary: Ugin conspires with Sarkhan, retakes the Meditation Realm and gains a way to spy through the Spirit-Gem on Bolas.
events.quote: Sarkhan helped Ugin bypass the wards that Bolas used to protect the Meditation Realm

events.summary: Ugin allies with Niv-Mizzet to plan his resurrection after Bolas kills him.
events.quote: Ugin allied with the Ravnican dragon Niv-Mizzet .

events.summary: Ugin sends Sarkhan for Hazoret's spear, which the resurrected Niv uses to impale Bolas before Bontu harvests his sparks.
events.quote: This enabled the God -Eternal Bontu to deliver the fatal blow

events.summary: Ugin takes Bolas's body to the Meditation Realm and has Jace conceal it with an illusion.
events.quote: Ugin took his brother's body to the Meditation Realm to prevent him from coming back to life on Ravnica.

events.summary: Bolas wakes powerless and nameless; Ugin merges his essence with the sealed Meditation Realm to watch him until his natural death.
events.quote: He'd also sealed the plane off from the rest of the multiverse

events.summary: Ugin speaks to Araithia and Liliana through the Spirit-Gem, and Liliana gives up the Chain Veil.
events.quote: Liliana dropped the Veil and gave it up.

events.summary: Jace, Vraska, Narset and Elspeth reach the Meditation Realm and meet Ugin and the nameless Bolas.
events.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power.

events.summary: Jace steals the Spirit-Gem and casts a reality-bending spell that fails and unmakes him.
events.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

events.summary: Ugin escapes to Tarkir and defeats Sarkhan with ghostfire, but Bolas has escaped.
events.quote: Bolas had escaped.
